scope: Static icon exports, source body centering independent of paint drip, hollow outlines, platform safe zones, and unchanged wordmark hashes. No app build or device/emulator installation was performed.

detail.method: Alpha-weighted pixel centers, alpha <=8 discarded, y<1000

checks.detail: Export master preserves original RGB values
Only alpha values at or below 8 are cleared

observations: Actual 48px standalone and native viewport outline proofs retain visible rim, hands, pivot and drip.
Hand and pivot interiors remain transparent; outlines do not form a filled silhouette.
Contact sheet shows centered main clock bodies and complete drips across Android, maskable web and Apple touch previews.
Black on light and white on dark outline variants are visually clear.
limitations: Mask previews approximate OS rendering. No device/emulator installation or app compilation was run.
